name: submit_waitlist
description: submit_waitlist: Place an employee on the waitlist for a desk or parking space when nothing is currently available in their preferred building or zone. Returns a waitlist ID and the employee's position in the queue.

employee_id.description: The employee to place on the waitlist (e.g. EMP048271).

resource_type.description: Whether the waitlist is for a desk or a parking space.

zone_or_building.description: The building code (for desks) or parking zone code (for parking) to waitlist for (e.g. BLD3 or PZA).
